scripts.build: pnpm --filter @model-auth/core build && pnpm --filter @model-auth/providers build && pnpm --filter @model-auth/vue build
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.pack: pnpm --dir packages/core pack --pack-destination ../../release && pnpm --dir packages/providers pack --pack-destination ../../release && pnpm --dir packages/vue pack --pack-destination ../../release
